meta.title: Zadrotometr — Discover Your Gaming Personality
meta.description: Discover your gaming personality type based on your Steam library. Fun AI-powered analysis.

landing.title: Zadrotometr
landing.tagline: What kind of gamer are you, really?
landing.subtitle: AI will analyze your Steam library and create your collectible card
landing.inputPlaceholder: Steam ID, profile link, or vanity URL
landing.disclaimer: Entertainment content, not a real psychoanalysis
landing.helpToggle: Where to find your Steam ID?
landing.helpStep2: Copy the URL from the address bar
landing.helpStep3: Paste it here — profile URL, vanity URL or SteamID64 all work

loading.step8: Just a bit more, it's worth the wait...
loading.funFact1: Did you know? The average Steam library has 89 games
loading.funFact2: Fun fact: 37% of Steam games have never been launched by their owners
loading.funFact3: Did you know? The average gamer plays 7.5 hours per week

explain.dedication: Total playtime + % of games actually played
explain.mastery: Focus on top games + achievements + average hours per game
explain.exploration: Library size + genre diversity + spread across games
explain.veteran: Account age + Steam level + badge count

wealth.title: Wallet
wealth.unpricedNote: The market doesn't know these items by name — their value isn't in the total
wealth.marketNote: Inventory is valued at quick-sale prices on a third-party market; inside Steam these items cost about a quarter more
wealth.estimatedNote: Part of the total is estimated from the average price
wealth.inventoryUnavailable: Couldn't fetch the inventory — Steam didn't respond, we'll try again later
wealth.inventoryPartial: Steam didn't return part of the inventory — that money isn't in the total
wealth.libraryPending: Library value will appear once the analysis is recalculated — the previous run used a different currency

patterns.title: Behavioral Patterns
patterns.genreConcentrationDesc: % of playtime in your top genre. Above 50% = genre loyalist, below 30% = omnivore
patterns.bingeDesc: How you spread your time: deep into one game, sampling everything, or balanced
patterns.indieDesc: Share of indie games in your library. Above 40% = indie connoisseur

ranks.title: Among All Players
ranks.subtitle: Rough estimate based on typical Steam player distribution — not a precise measurement
ranks.libraryDesc: Number of games in your collection
ranks.concentrationDesc: How much you stick to your top games
ranks.subtitleReal: Your rank among everyone who has taken the test

psychoProfile.bigFiveDesc: Psychological profile based on gaming preferences

invalidInput.title: Invalid format
invalidInput.description: Could not recognize the Steam profile. Please check your input.
steps: Copy the URL from the address bar

profileNotFound.title: Profile not found
profileNotFound.description: Could not find a Steam profile with this link.
steps: Check the URL or SteamID is correct

privateProfile.title: Private profile
privateProfile.description: This Steam profile is private. Game data needs to be public.
steps: Wait a couple minutes and try again

hiddenLibrary.title: Library hidden
hiddenLibrary.description: Profile is public but the game library is hidden in privacy settings.
steps: Wait a couple minutes and try again

fewGames.title: Too few games
fewGames.description: You need at least 5 games in your library for analysis. Not enough data yet.

emptyLibrary.title: Empty library
emptyLibrary.description: No games found in the library or data is unavailable. The library may be hidden in Steam privacy settings.
steps: Wait a couple minutes and try again

noPlaytime.title: Playtime data hidden
noPlaytime.description: Games are in the library, but playtime data is unavailable. Most likely, game stats are hidden in Steam privacy settings.
steps: Make sure 'Playtime' is also set to Public
Wait a couple minutes and try again

steamUnavailable.title: Steam unavailable
steamUnavailable.description: Steam servers are temporarily not responding. Usually resolves in a few minutes.

analysisError.title: Analysis error
analysisError.description: Something went wrong while creating your card. Please try again.

timeout.title: Request timed out
timeout.description: The server took too long to respond. A retry is usually faster — the result may already be cached.

errors.expired: Analysis has expired. Click to re-analyze

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.description: Please wait a moment and try again.

teaser.title: Your Card is Almost Ready!
teaser.subtitle: We dug through your Steam library and found some wild stuff...
teaser.feature1: Your 3 archetypes — who are you in the gaming world?
teaser.feature2: Big Five psycho profile — the truth about you
teaser.feature3: 6 roasts that will hit where it hurts
teaser.feature4: AI art — your gaming spirit visualized
teaser.generatingHint: This takes about a minute and a half — keep the tab open
teaser.failedHint: The AI didn't answer in time. Your Steam data is already collected — hit retry, the second run usually goes through.
teaser.expiredHint: The analysis timed out while the card was being built. Run it again — it's quick.

footer.disclaimer: Entertainment content. Not a medical or psychological assessment. Not affiliated with Valve Corporation.

auth.taken: This login is already linked to another account. Sign in with it, or unlink it there first.
auth.codeHint: Open the bot — it will send you a code. Enter it here, it works for 10 minutes.
auth.codeWrong: That code didn't work. Check you entered all of it, or get a new one from the bot.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait an hour and try again.
auth.sameMethod: Bought a read before? Sign in the same way you did last time — the purchase is tied to it. A different way creates a new account, and you'd have to pay again.

paywall.title: That was the free part
paywall.subtitle: You've seen the verdict. Everything else is waiting behind the button — and it's a lot more than a couple of lines.

paywall.disclaimer: Entertainment, not a psychologist's report. You're buying a joke about yourself, not a diagnosis.
paywall.lockedHint: There are no real words down here on purpose — they show up once you pay.
paywall.loginHint: Sign in so the purchase sticks. It's tied to your account, not to this browser.
paywall.alreadyOwned: You already own this read — refreshing the page.
paywall.failed: Couldn't start the payment. Give it another go.
paywall.expired: The analysis expired while you were reading. Refresh the page and it will be recomputed.
paywall.unavailable: Payments aren't hooked up yet — there's nothing to buy right now.

pay.testModeHint: A practice checkout. It never touches your card: the payment is pretend, the access you get is real.
pay.title: Checkout
pay.subject: Read for {name}
pay.failed: The confirmation never left. Give it another go.
pay.closed: This order is already closed — there's nothing left to pay.
pay.disclaimer: Entertainment, not a psychologist's report. You're buying a joke about yourself, not a diagnosis.

return.title: Back from checkout
return.waiting: Waiting for the bank to confirm...
return.waitingHint: Usually a couple of seconds. Best to leave this page open.
return.paid: Payment confirmed — opening your full read.
return.declined: The bank declined the payment. Nothing was charged, the read stays free.
return.delayed: The bank is taking its time. It happens: the money is gone, the notice is still in transit.
return.stillWaiting: Still no confirmation. Check back in a minute — access opens on its own.
return.signedOut: Looks like you're signed out. The payment is fine, but the read only opens once you're signed in — go back to it and sign in the same way as before.
